触发按钮操作时播放提示音，音频播放期间自动静默。: Play audio feedback for actions, staying silent during playback.
专辑封面仅支持 JPEG 与 PNG 格式。: Album covers must be in JPEG or PNG format.
音频文件体积过大，磁盘临时空间不足以展开。: Not enough temporary disk space to load this audio file.
音频长度或体积超出该格式的上限，未能保存。当前编辑仍完整保留在此窗口中。: File exceeds the size limit for this format. Your edits remain in this window.
音频长度或体积超出该格式的上限，无法导出。: This file exceeds the size limit for the selected format.
直接复制音频流，不重新编码，音质零损耗。: Copies the audio stream directly without re-encoding. Zero quality loss.
仅更新曲目元数据，不重新编码音频，音质零损耗。: Updates track metadata only without re-encoding. Zero quality loss.
音频将重新进行有损编码，音质会产生轻微损耗。: Re-encoding to a lossy format will slightly reduce audio fidelity.
有损压缩会舍弃部分高频细节，原文件不受影响。: Lossy compression discards high-frequency detail. The original file is not modified.
转为无损格式会增加文件体积，但无法恢复原文件已流失的音质细节。: Converting to a lossless format increases file size, but won't restore detail already lost in the source.
MP3 采样率上限为 48 kHz，超出部分将自动重采样。: MP3 supports up to 48 kHz. The sample rate will be resampled accordingly.
目标格式不支持当前采样率，导出时将自动转换。: This format doesn't support the source sample rate and will be resampled automatically.
MP3 最多支持双声道，多声道音频将缩混为立体声。: MP3 supports up to two channels. Multi-channel audio will be downmixed to stereo.
目标格式的声道数量受限，多余声道将自动缩混。: This format has a channel limit. Extra channels will be downmixed automatically.
原音频位深超过 24-bit，导出后将转换为 24-bit。: Source bit depth exceeds 24-bit and will be converted to 24-bit upon saving.
M4A 格式当前仅支持读取，修改后将另存为新文件，原文件保持不变。: M4A is currently read-only. Changes save as a new file without modifying the original.
当前 Windows 系统缺少 M4A 解码组件，请在系统「可选功能」中安装「媒: Windows is missing the M4A decoder. Please install the "Media Feature Pack" under Windows Optional Features.
